mapper.insert: INSERT INTO goods_comment (goods_id, user_id, content, parent_id, create_time) VALUES (#{goodsId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, u.nickname as nickname, u.avatar as avatar, pu.nickname as parentNickname FROM goods_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN goods_comment pc ON c.parent_id = pc.comment_id LEFT JOIN sys_user pu ON pc.user_id = pu.user_id WHERE c.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY c.create_time ASC
